g.text: 128 training / 159 development Cases | shared Transformer + joint segmentation
Exploratory follow-up on an already observed development cohort; Case-to-patient mapping unverified; no clinical validation.
Frozen image features; no augmentation; final epoch 50 fixed. Same updates/data exposure; four steps use more compute.
Only five NEW seeds in these figures; earlier three excluded. Means are not ensembles; sample SD is not a confidence interval.
